summary.text: Mary Beth Carozza is a Republican Maryland state senator from District 38, representing Somerset, Worcester and Wicomico counties, who has held the seat since January 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She previously served in the House of Delegates and held senior roles on congressional, gubernatorial and Defense Department staffs.

paragraphs.text: Mary Beth Carozza was born in Baltimore on February 13, 1961, and graduated from Stephen Decatur High School in Berlin, Maryland, in 1979.
She earned a B.A. and an M.A. from the Catholic University of America in political philosophy and American government.
Her career began as press secretary to U.S. Sen. William Cohen from 1984 to 1986, followed by service as chief of staff to U.S. Rep. Mike DeWine from 1986 to 1990.

She later worked for U.S. Rep. David Lee Hobson, as a deputy assistant secretary of defense for House affairs from 2001 to 2003, as deputy chief of staff to Gov. Robert Ehrlich from 2003 to 2007, and as deputy chief of staff to U.S. Sen. Susan Collins from 2007 to 2009.
Carozza was chief of staff to U.S. Rep. Steve Stivers from 2011 to 2012 and founded MBS Consulting, LLC, in 2013.
Carozza represented District 38C in the Maryland House of Delegates before moving to the Senate.
She assumed office in the state Senate on January 9, 2019.
According to the General Assembly website, she serves on the Education, Energy, and the Environment Committee and the Executive Nominations Committee.
